source: Kalshi official public historical and recent markets + 1-minute candle

validation.method: rolling prior-only probability bins with shrinkage; no future labels and same-series only
validation.warning: Research-only backtest. Independent final holdout, uncertainty, regime analysis, fee economics and real-time forward performance remain required.

independent_audit.method: predeclared market benchmark vs bucket/shrinkage, tuned before locked chronological 100-window holdout
independent_audit.selection_policy: model chosen on prior resolved tuning only; no selecting best test model; holdout never trains or selects
independent_audit.warning: Even a historical positive locked holdout is not sufficient for live signals: forward tests, fees, liquidity, regime consistency, and risk policy remain unverified.
